evidenceRefs.description: Evidence URIs the provider stamped; empty when the verdict is `Pending`.

evaluatedAt.description: UTC stamp the provider returned; matches the record's `evaluated_at`.

evaluator.description: Provider-defined evaluator string (operator name, model id, or `"system"`).

description:
Per-gate wire shape for `GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/verification`.
The verdict string is the lower-case `GateVerdict` smart-type
name (`pending` / `passed` / `failed`); the evidence URI
is returned as a plain string so the FE can resolve it through the
existing artifact endpoint without the engine re-encoding the URL.
